guard: bare status checks only the selected registration unless --all, reports a part it cannot read as partial with a named warning, prints its sections in the agreed order with the hints last, and refuses --components with --all
command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/status-report.smoke.ts
why: The suite drives the built binary, so each mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back.
